parsed.notes: The filing does not disclose actual ratio values; it says only that the company was in compliance as of June 30, 2026. The Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio pricing grid, which sets interest margins and the 0.25%-0.35% unused fee, is excluded because it only determines pricing. The 2.75x pro forma threshold restricting certain transactions is also excluded, as it is a transaction-restriction test rather than a maintenance covenant. The company had no outstanding borrowings at June 30, 2026.
